_comment: MQTT client configuration — used by mqtt_device_controller.py, mqtt_gui_controller.py, and connection_manager.py

local_broker._comment: Phase 1 — local network broker (Mosquitto on your laptop or Pi)

cloud_broker._comment: Phase 2 — WAN / cloud broker (HiveMQ public cluster, no auth required)

credentials._comment: Leave username empty for anonymous access (local + HiveMQ public). Fill in for private brokers.

topics._comment: MQTT topic map — all components read topics from here so you only change them in one place

tls._comment: TLS settings for WAN phase — set enabled to true and fill in cert paths when using a private broker over port 8883
